draft_en.subject: GEMS2 / GEUS range - a second ODM source in your housing
draft_en.body:
Hi Christopher,

Over the past months you had a few product mails from us - most recently "16 Port Industrial PoE Switch" on 17 September 2026 - and there was no reason to answer a mass mail. This one is specific.

For the GEMS2 / GEUS switch and media-converter range, a second ODM source in your housing from small lots, -40 to 75 C, FCC/CE/RoHS: GEMS2-8T position - DIN-rail 8 x Gigabit PoE+ + 2 x SFP, L2 managed, Marvell-based - model STI-288GPM - $85.5 USD EXW (MOQ 1, 15-day validity); GEUS-5T position - DIN-rail 5 x Gigabit unmanaged - STI-050GE - $18.5; media converter, 1 x RJ45 + 1 x SFP - STI-110GE - $26.5.

One question: which of the three do you reorder most for the traffic and government jobs?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
